In detail

A large district combining the historic, touristed Óbuda old town (Roman ruins, riverside) with the big Békásmegyer housing-estate area. A 2022 police-data comparison found District III had the third-highest residential-burglary count in the city (101 cases, behind Zugló's 113 and just ahead of Újbuda's 99) — a genuine, sourced property-crime signal, though it is not named in any violent-crime or nightlife-disorder hotspot list. Sources checked: Index.hu, 16 May 2022 (district burglary comparison, PRE-STAT data).
